subject: Help!: send a email from a shinyapps.io. App.

messages.author: 7eec58483e5d4f79
messages.subject: Help!: send a email from a shinyapps.io. App.
parts:
Hi:

I'm testing a script (shiny) which must be able to send a email. I performed successfully the next example from a local server, but it fails when is tested from shinyapps.io.

There is a problem with the smtp in shinyapps.io?

Thanks,

MVC


------------------
ui.R
------------------
fluidPage(
  mainPanel(
    textInput("value", "value:", "Empty"),
    actionButton("button",label = "Send")
    
  )
)

------------------
server.R
------------------
library("mailR")
library("shiny")

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  observeEvent(input$button, {
        send.mail(from = "te...@gmail.com",
              to = "te...@gmail.com",
              subject = "Subject of the email",
              body = "Body of the email",
              smtp = list(host.name = "smtp.gmail.com", port = 465, user.name = "mye...@gmail.com", passwd = "mypass",                   ssl = TRUE),
              authenticate = TRUE,
              send = TRUE)
    
    updateTextInput(session,"value", "value:", "Ok")
  })

}
